sections.appearance: Wakamo has yellow eyes and long, dark brown hair that reaches down to her feet. Atop her head are two red fox ears that fade into dark brown. She also has a bushy dark brown fox tail tied with a big white bow at the end, which fades into blue and red. Halo ==== Her halo appears to be a black cherry blossom with red outlines and a red star in its center, surrounded by a large red circle with 5 red spikes, two longer than the others. Uniform ==== Wakamo wears a short black kimono, accentuated with golden and white cherry blossoms, a lace choker on her neck and asymmetrical leggings and boots, where the left leg adorns a glossy red sock with a black strap attached to her thigh while the right leg uses a ripped flower-patterned legging with a bluish black shoe. After her event, she occasionally walks around the city in a more traditional pink kimono. Usually, she wears a traditional kitsune fox mask. Firearm ==== She uses a black Type 99 Arisaka bolt-action rifle with a red handguard. A kitsune mask decal is imprinted along the cheek rest. The red half of the hand guard is decorated with black cherry blossom patterns. A red tassel is attached to the pommel of the bayonet.

sections.personality: Wakamo is naturally inclined to anarchy and destruction, preferring to cause chaos and rampage wherever she goes. This got her into trouble with the Valkyrie Police Academy and imprisoned in the Corrections Bureau before she escaped following the disappearance of the GSC President. However after meeting Sensei, this changes slightly. Though she still has a desire for violence, sadism and destruction, her feelings are tempered by her obsession and love for Sensei, of through some convincing, has managed to restrain herself; as such, she generally tries to hold back and not cause too much trouble to them.
